// Recent Work

From the roof to the wall to the yard.

Real jobs, done around Bloemfontein and the wider Free State — electrical, solar and plumbing, side by side.

Solar Panel Installations
Roof-mounted arrays, sized and angled for Free State sun.
Solar Inverter Installation
Inverter, distribution boards and battery — neat conduit runs, properly labelled.
Battery & Backup Storage
Battery banks paired with the main distribution board for full backup power.
Dual Battery Backup Systems
Bigger households, bigger buffer — dual battery setups for longer backup runtime.
Distribution & Surge Protection
Changeover switches and surge protection, wired to survive load shedding.
Distribution Board Wiring
Labelled circuits, earth leakage protection, and a tidy layout on every board.
Water Storage Systems
Storage tanks plumbed in with pressure pumps for backup water supply.
Pressure Pump Installation
Pumps wired safely with weatherproof connections, built to last outdoors.
Plumbing Pipework & Valves
Multi-valve manifolds for irrigation and water systems, built for easy control.
Conduit Roughing-In
Conduit and boxes chased in neatly before the plaster goes back on.
New Build Wiring
Wiring done right from the start, on new builds and renovations alike.
Gate Motors
Supply, install, and repair for sliding and swing gates.
